rule: End-of-zone presentation driven by a server state change. svc_intermission sets state 1, svc_finale sets state 2 with a text id, svc_cutscene sets state 3 with text. Each forces the full-screen view. Centre text is typed at a cvar rate (default 8 characters per second). Lightning beams last 0.2 seconds and stay up only while the server keeps re-sending them. Explosions add a 350-radius light for 0.5 seconds. Doors have speed, wait (3 s default, -1 never), lip and damage data. Armour absorbs a fraction of damage per armour type (0.3, 0.6, 0.8), capped at the armour value. No boss monster code is in this tree.

data_fields.name: armour_fraction
data_fields.unit: fraction of damage per armour type
